summary.text: Josh Becker was elected to the California State Senate in November 2020 and represents the 13th Senate District, which comprises most of San Mateo County and the northern part of Santa Clara County.

paragraphs.text: He created Full Circle, a community leadership and policy innovation organization, in 2000; was appointed by Gov. Jerry Brown to the California State Workforce Development Board, on which he served seven years; and was CEO of the legal analytics company Lex Machina.
Becker earned a JD/MBA from Stanford University in 1999 and has lived in Menlo Park for 20 years.
